parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with high QRS voltage (very deep S waves in V2-V3 plus a tall R in aVL, Cornell sum well over 28 mm); the concave ST elevation with tall upright T waves in V2-V4 is the expected secondary repolarization pattern, with no reciprocal changes or convex ST elevation, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
